desc: prints information about a libpspell installation
u: pspell-config - prints information about a libpspell installation

pspell-config displays information about libpspell installation, mostly for use in build scripts. Note that this script is provided for backward compatibility with programs that use pspell. Do not use as it will eventually go away.

--version
outputs version information about the installed pspell
--datadir
displays the data directory
--pkgdatadir
displays the aspell package directory
